title: Act 3: one cloud system, one sheet of sky, slower
lede: The drifting oval clouds are gone; the sky is only the liquid renderer. Every sky cloud sits on one sheet seen out to the horizon: near ones big and high, far ones small, flat and crowding the horizon. The sky changes over minutes.
